title: The Leeward Landfall
author: Theo Yarrow
blurb: Rafael Thornbury, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
